_about: R5 accent colours, macOS 27.2.1 (26B131). One process per accent, accent passed via the NSArgumentDomain (no defaults written). Colours resolved inside NSAppearance aqua (light) / darkAqua (dark) via performAsCurrentDrawingAppearance and converted to sRGB 0..255 (alpha 0..1). Private AppKit functions used read-only: NSColorEnumerateUserAccentColors/HighlightColors, NSColorGetUserAccentColor, NSColorGetUserHighlightColor, NSColorLocalizedNameFor*, NSColorDisplayColorForUserHighlightKey, NSColorBaseDisplayImageForUserAccentKey, NSUserHighlightColorForUserAccentKey.
accentKeyNotes: Appearance pane on this Mac offers exactly 9: Multicolor(-2 = key absent), Graphite(-1), Red 0, Orange 1, Yellow 2, Green 3, Blue 4, Purple 5, Pink 6 (NSColorEnumerateUserAccentColors order: -2,4,5,6,0,1,2,3,-1).

Extra key -3 "This Mac" (hardware enclosure colour, AppKit strings DeviceEnclosureColor / controlAccentEnclosure%iColor) is enumerated only on Macs with a coloured enclosure; not offered on this MacBook Air M2. Simulated values below (NSColorSimulateHardwareAccent / NSColorSimulatedHardwareEnclosureNumber argument-domain flags).
Values 7, 8, 9, -3 (without hardware) and -2 resolve to Multicolor (invalid = absent).
Argument domain: negative values must be passed as plist, e.g. -AppleAccentColor "<integer>-1</integer>"; a bare "-1" is parsed as a new key and silently ignored.
Graphite (-1) maps to highlight key 8 "Graphite"; every colour accent maps to the highlight key with the same number; Multicolor maps to highlight -1 "Automatic".

highlightColor.AppleHighlightColorAbsent: selectedTextBackgroundColor follows the accent (highlight key -1 "Automatic"); e.g. Purple accent -> #DFC5E0 light / #705771 dark.
highlightColor.defaultsFormat: AppKit _userDefaultValueForHighlightColor writes "%f %f %f %@" (r g b Name). Name strings in AppKit next to that format: Orange, Purple, Brown, Graphite, ThisMac (plus Red/Yellow/Green/Blue/Pink/Other, de-duplicated elsewhere in the string pool). Exact rgb written by Settings for 27.2.1 not observed (writing is forbidden here); the light-appearance display colours are listed in highlightKeys, e.g. Blue would be "0.701961 0.843137 1.000000 Blue" if AppKit writes the sRGB display colour (unverified; pre-Big Sur value was "0.698039 0.843137 1.000000 Blue").
highlightColor.parsing: Reader keys on the trailing name (case-sensitive): Red/Orange/Yellow/Green/Blue/Purple/Pink/Graphite -> that key, rgb ignored. "Accent" and "ThisMac" -> Automatic (-1) (ThisMac falls back to Automatic without hardware accent). "Other" -> Choose Color (-2), rgb used but softened per appearance (#BBC2CA/#474E56 for 0.1 0.2 0.3). Unknown names ("Automatic", "Multicolor", "Brown", "accent") or rgb only -> custom colour used verbatim in both appearances. Empty string -> Automatic.
highlightColor.graphiteHighlightDark: Explicit Graphite highlight in dark = white a0.247; Graphite accent with Automatic highlight in dark = #696969 a1.

multicolor.meaning: Multicolor = AppleAccentColor absent. Each app uses its own accent from Info.plist NSAccentColorName or NSAppAccentColorName (asset-catalog colour name); apps without one get Blue (#007AFF). Choosing any explicit accent overrides app accents (verified with scratch bundles carrying a copied Assets.car + Info.plist key: Notes-like bundle -> #FCB827 under Multicolor, #007AFF with -AppleAccentColor 4). Automatic highlight follows the app accent (Notes-like: selectedTextBackground #FEEABF / #8A764B). Both plist keys behave the same (Freeform colour tested with either key). AppKit also contains NSMulticolorAccent / NSMulticolorHighlight image names (swatches).
multicolor.catalogSystemColorNote: Asset colours that reference a system colour (System Color Name in assetutil) resolve to the 27.2.1 system colour, not the stored components: systemBlue -> #0088FF light / #0091FF dark (Mail, Contacts, TV, Siri AI), systemCyan -> #00C0E8/#3CD3FE (Freeform), systemRed -> #FF383C/#FF4245 (Calendar), systemPurple -> #CB30E0/#DB34F2.
multicolor.appsWithoutAccentKey: Music, Photos, Messages, Maps, Reminders, Preview, FaceTime, System Settings, App Store, Weather, Passwords, Safari, Finder: no accent key -> Blue #007AFF under Multicolor.
